ns2:section.sectionText: ECON HONORS SECTION. Currently, only Econ James Scholars or Econ CHS may register for this section. This course will be designated as a course counting towards the ECON honors program criteria which will be available in the Spring~ and is NOT specifically approved for other honors programs (CHP/James Scholars- please speak with your honors office to discuss your honors requirements). Other seats in this section are reserved for economics students who are invited to be in the honors section of this course following the end of the Fall semester when eligible students will receive an email with an invitation and information on registering. The Department will set the eligibility standards based on Economics GPA and other honor status. NOOVERRIDES WILL BE PROVIDED AT THIS TIME.
